name: Fish in a Bucket
summary: In Shadowprey Village, Jinar'Zillen leaves the shellfish gathering to others. The traps lie below the docks, and he offers a Bloodbelly fish for every five shellfish.

sections.title: Work Done by Someone Else
sections.body: Jinar'Zillen keeps many shellfish traps below the docks of Shadowprey Village. He would rather someone else gather from them, and offers a fine Bloodbelly fish for every five shellfish brought in.

aliases: who gives fish in a bucket
faq.answer: Jinar'Zillen offers the trade in Shadowprey Village, in Desolace.
The shellfish traps lie below the docks of Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: Why does Jinar'Zillen want someone else to gather the shellfish?
faq.answer: Jinar'Zillen likes to do as little as possible, so he promises a return to anyone who gathers from the traps.

faq.q: What does Jinar'Zillen give in return for the shellfish?
faq.answer: Jinar'Zillen gives one fine Bloodbelly fish for every five shellfish.
